card.name: Words leading into 'alone' or 'on its own'
card.fires_on: The word just before a phrase meaning by itself, such as 'alone', 'as single agents', 'on their own' or 'as a separate entity'. It fires on 'administered', 'used', 'stand', 'or' or 'drug' when a standalone sense comes next.
